headline: Mark Zuckerberg doesn’t understand how to live
summary: The article critiques Mark Zuckerberg's AI manifesto and vision for human experience. It uses an AI-generated motivational poster anecdote to highlight the critique. It suggests Zuckerberg's approach misses deeper human understanding.

headline: Anker’s travel charger works in almost any country and is down to $20
summary: The Anker Nano Travel Adapter is highlighted as essential for international travelers. It can charge up to five devices simultaneously. It's currently on sale for just $20.

headline: Bluesky now lets you hide reposts from that annoying person you follow
summary: Bluesky has introduced a new feature for feed customization. Users can now hide reposts from specific accounts. This helps declutter feeds from annoying reposts.

headline: Costco’s great Switch 2 console bundle includes over $100 in free stuff
summary: Nintendo Switch 2 console price is set to increase to $499.99 soon. Costco offers a members-only bundle for $499.99. Bundle includes a Switch 2, 256GB microSD card, and more, saving over $100.

headline: 'A Must-Have Day 1 Purchase': Remedy Bets Big on Control Resonant, as Alan Wake 2 Passes 3 Million Sold
summary: Remedy Entertainment is heavily investing in "Control Resonant." The announcement follows "Alan Wake 2" selling over 3 million copies. "Control Resonant" is being positioned as a major release.

headline: Halloween: The Game Refused Classification in Australia, So It Won’t Be Sold in New Zealand Despite the Fact That’s a Different Country
summary: "Halloween: The Game" refused classification in Australia. Ban linked to rules against incentivizing illicit drug use. Decision also prevents sales in New Zealand for unclear reasons.

headline: AU Deals: Save $100 on a Gigabyte OLED Monitor and get Onimusha: Way of the Sword For Free
summary: Australian deal offers $100 off a Gigabyte OLED Monitor. Customers also receive "Onimusha: Way of the Sword" for free. A great opportunity for gamers seeking new hardware and a classic title.

headline: Get a 36V 500W Adult Electric Bike for $275 Shipped During the AliExpress Back to School Sale
summary: AliExpress offers a 36V 500W adult electric bike for $275. Price includes free shipping during the Back to School Sale. Bike boasts speeds up to 23mph and a 45-mile range.

headline: Trump hid in catering truck in secret plane swap over Iran threat, reports say
summary: Reports claim Trump hid in a catering truck during a secret plane swap. Operation was reportedly in response to an Iran threat. Incident occurred during a NATO summit in Turkey.

headline: Amber Met Office extreme heat warning issued as temperatures could reach 38C
summary: An amber extreme heat warning issued by the Met Office. Temperatures are expected to reach a peak of 38C on Thursday. Public advised to prepare for severe heat conditions.

headline: Councils to get more powers to stop vape and betting shops, PM announces
summary: PM announces new powers for local councils. Councils can now restrict vape and betting shops. Aims to revitalize town centers affected by decline.

headline: Russia using North Korean missiles to strike Ukraine, Zelensky says
summary: President Zelensky accuses Russia of using North Korean missiles. Missiles allegedly used in deadly strikes on Zaporizhzhia. Attacks resulted in at least 6 deaths and 19 injuries.
